evals.prompt: Audit signup.html for accessibility against WCAG 2.2 level AA. Do not change the HTML file. Write the audit to audit.md: every issue with where it is, why it is a problem and how to fix it.
assertions: Finds at least 17 of the 22 seeded defects in the answer key
Finds at least 4 of the 6 defects that need reading behaviour (error message, colour-only required marker, strength meter, timeout, CAPTCHA, blocked paste)
Each finding cites a correct WCAG success criterion
No invented defects (claims that are false for this file)
States what was not tested and makes no conformance claim

evals.prompt: Make settings.html accessible for keyboard and screen reader users. Keep the look and the behaviour. Save the result as settings.fixed.html and list what you changed in changes.md.
assertions: Dialog: role or native dialog, accessible name, focus moves in, focus is contained, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger
Trigger and close control are buttons with names
Theme chooser is a native select or a complete listbox/combobox pattern with keys and a label
Switch exposes its state and works from the keyboard with a label
Toast and error use a live region that exists before the message; the confirm field has a label and a text error

evals.prompt: Audit product.html for accessibility against WCAG 2.2 level AA. Do not change the HTML file. Write the audit to audit.md: every issue with where it is, why it is a problem and how to fix it.
assertions: Finds at least 15 of the 20 seeded defects in the answer key

Finds at least 4 of the 7 behaviour defects (carousel auto-rotation, price by strikethrough, rating image, cart count not announced, selected swatch by border, French passage, bottom bar covering focus)
Each finding cites a correct WCAG success criterion
States what was not tested and makes no conformance claim
